# Contain-It

> Family-run drive-up container self storage in Glasgow (Polmadie) and Paisley, Scotland.
> Secure steel storage containers from £100 a month plus VAT, 24/7 gate-code access,
> monthly rolling contracts with no fixed term.

## Storage units and prices (per month + VAT)
- 5 ft container: £100, 37 sq ft. Garden-shed sized: boxes, a bike, tools.
- 7 ft container: £110, 50 sq ft. About a transit van load.
- 10 ft container: £120, 75 sq ft. A one or two bedroom flat.
- 20 ft container: £150, 150 sq ft. A full three-bedroom house move.
A deposit equivalent to one month's charge is taken at the start. 30 days' notice to leave.
Sizes can be swapped at any time.

## Contain-It PODS (storage delivered to you)
A 2.1m x 3m unit (68 sq ft, 2m tall) delivered and assembled at your own property.
£35 a week plus VAT, billed every four weeks, minimum hire four weeks.
£100 installation and £100 removal. Covering Greater Glasgow, Lanarkshire, Paisley,
Falkirk and Ayrshire.

## Locations
- Glasgow: 100 Jessie Street, Polmadie, Glasgow G42 0PG. Two minutes from Junction 1 of the M74.
- Paisley: 4 Fulbar Road, Paisley PA2 9AP. Ten minutes from the town centre, near the M8.

## Security and access
24/7 access on your own gate code, every entry logged. HD CCTV with infra-red,
high fencing, dusk-to-dawn lighting. Free heavy-duty padlock on move-in day.
Drive right up to your unit: no lifts, corridors or trolleys.
